name: Block Puzzle (REWARDS)
desc:
❓ Hey there! Ready for more fun? Join the group for the latest updates and info!
👍 Like the game to qualify for any future FREE LIMITED UGC
💎 Have Premium? Enjoy a 20% bonus towards money you earn 💸

🎮 How to Play:

🤲 Drag and drop the blocks onto the board.
💥 Clear the blocks when a column or row is filled.
🌟 We'll keep sending you new blocks until you have no space left on the board.
🤔 Plan your next move as you think constantly about what blocks might show up.
🏆 The more combos you make, the more points you score!
🚀 Climb the Friend Leaderboard!

📱 🎮 💻 Available on Mobile, Console (XBOX, PlayStation 5/PS5), PC, and VR

Coming Soon:
🎉 Special Gamemodes

🔔 Join the community through social links to receive exclusive updates!
